info.title: Hea Public API
info.description:
Hea REST API — Complete MVP specification aligned with Architecture Document v4.3.

**Changes in v2.0:**
- ✅ Added /auth/request-otp endpoint (P0)
- ✅ Fixed WhatsApp webhook with GET verification (P0)
- ✅ Added Voice Service API complete (P0)
- ✅ Added health/ready/version endpoints (P0)
- ✅ Fixed User.locale syntax and added enum (P0)
- ✅ Added PATCH /users/me for profile updates (P1)
- ✅ Extended Consent schema with emergency contact (P1)
- ✅ Expanded Admin API (user management, escalation triage) (P1)
- ✅ Added specific error codes enum (P1)
- ✅ Enhanced Report schema (JSON export, metadata) (P1)
- ✅ Added /users/me/risk-profile endpoint (P1)
- ✅ Improved Page schema (total, hasMore) (P1)
- ✅ Added /news/personalized endpoint (P2)
- ✅ Added LLM sub-endpoints for debugging (P2)
- ✅ Added rate limit documentation (x-rate-limit)
- ✅ Added comprehensive examples

**Standards:**
- All endpoints use JSON
- Time is ISO-8601 UTC
- Idempotent writes support `Idempotency-Key`
- JWT authentication via Bearer token
- Cursor-based pagination for scalability

**Contact:**
- Email: api-support@hea.health
- Docs: https://docs.tryhea.com

bearerAuth.description:
JWT token obtained via /auth/login.
Format: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
Client-supplied UUID for idempotent writes.
Prevents duplicate operations within 24h window.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for next page (null if no more pages)

total.description: Total count (may be null for performance)

type.description:
- privacy: Core service consent (required)
- marketing: Marketing communications
- emergency: Emergency contact sharing
- research: Anonymous data for research

title.example: New Study Links Sleep Quality to Heart Health

severity.description:
- critical: Life-threatening (999 recommended)
- high: Urgent medical attention needed (24h)
- medium: Non-urgent GP appointment recommended
- low: Informational/tracking

message.example: Experiencing severe chest pain for 30 minutes

visibleName.description: Whether referrer name is visible to referee

text.example: I've been having headaches for the past week

intent.description: Pre-classified intent (optional, will auto-detect if null)

text.example: I'm sorry to hear about your headaches. Let me ask a few questions...

audioUrl.description: TTS audio URL (if voice output requested)

userId.description: User who performed action (null for system)
